title: 6.7.24 Challenges — SliderJoint, Trebuchet, Swinging Rope
description: Three optional stretch prompts for Unit 2.7: build a SliderJoint piston sandbox, a trebuchet that uses a DistanceJoint + HingeJoint together, or a swinging rope chain with three or more HingeJoints.

steps.title: Create a canvas
steps.instructions: Inside setup(), create a canvas of any size.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and find the Canvas section.

steps.title: Create at least one sprite
steps.instructions: In setup(), create at least one sprite.
hints: Check the Sprite section of the shplay docs drawer for constructor arguments.

steps.title: Clear the background each frame
steps.instructions: Call background() inside draw() so old frames don't stack up.
hints: Search the shplay docs drawer for background().

steps.title: Use one stretch joint feature
steps.instructions: Pick one challenge from content.md and implement it. Any of the three prompts — SliderJoint sandbox, trebuchet, or swinging rope — will satisfy this requirement.
hints: content.md describes all three challenges with API hints. Pick the one that interests you most.

requirements.title: Create a canvas
requirements.description: A canvas is created when the sketch starts.

requirements.title: Create at least one sprite
requirements.description: A sprite exists in the sketch.

requirements.title: Use at least one stretch joint feature
requirements.description: Your sketch uses a SliderJoint, a HingeJoint chain (3+ linked sprites), or a trebuchet combining DistanceJoint and HingeJoint.
